title: Works well at removing smoke odors.
text: Works well at removing smoke odors.. My wife's doing a Reno in a condo where heavy smokers lived and smoke wafted up from the smokers below until she had it sealed off. The smoke had permeated everything. She reports that it is doing an excellent job of removing the smoke odors during the renovation.

product_metadata.title: New Comfort SS12000 Commercial Ozone Generator and Air Purifier 9000 to 20000 mg/hr
features: POWERFUL OZONE GENERATOR - The 03-7000 Industrial unit can produce 9,000 or 20,000 mg an hour which will take care of your toughest odor problems!
POWERFUL OZONE GENERATOR - The 03-7000 Industrial unit can produce 9,000 or 20,000 mg an hour which will take care of your toughest odor problems!
DESTROYS ODORS AT THE SOURCE - Smoke Damage, Pet Odors, Pesticides, Cleaning Fume Odors, Cigarette Smoke, Mold & Mildew, Virus's, Paint Odors, Cooking Odors, Water Damage, Decaying material and more.

CONTINUOUS RUN or 120 MINUTE TIMER - This ozone generator can be ran on continuous mode or has a timer that can be set for 1-120 minutes, so it can automatically shut off before you return which gives time for the area to properly air out before return.
ADJUSTABLE OZONE OUTPUT - Easily control how much ozone is generated per hour. (9,000 mg/h or 20,000 mg/h)
